extraction.notes: AVB reports no AFFO metric; affo fields null. Starting line and all amounts are Q2 2026 (three months) column from page seq 12 (printed 10). Zero-value lines (Casualty loss, Hedge accounting activity) omitted from adjustments since they are shown as dashes for Q2 2026. Categorization judgments: 'Unconsolidated entity activity' is mainly unrealized gains on property tech/sustainability funds plus JV distributions, mapped to investment_gain_loss; 'Other real estate activity' (includes gains on sale of non-operating real estate) mapped to other; SIP loan reserve, advocacy contributions and income tax mapped to other. Diluted shares 141,834,769 printed in full, divided by 1,000; reproduces FFO $2.73 and Core FFO $2.86. Recurring capex: only YTD 2026 Asset Preservation Capex ($106,450 thousand total, residential Same Store plus Non-Same Store) is disclosed; no quarterly figure found, so the YTD figure is recorded with basis year_to_date and may not be a like-for-like recurring capex measure.
